content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Post Doctoral Fellow Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The PDF applicant should be an Indian citizen. The PDF is awarded to researchers with a proven academic record, including peer-reviewed publications and recognitions. PDF applicants currently in regular employment will not be considered. Scientists or researchers with temporary positions in academia or research institutions would be considered, but they would be required to relinquish their current roles if selected for the fellowship. PDF applicants should not have completed their PhD at the same institution (host institution) where the PDF fellowship is to be awarded. The research proposal of the PDF applicant, to be submitted to the institution, should define clear objectives, outcomes and deliverables against the award. Preference would be given to the PDF applicants who have active industry linkages and their research proposal is directed towards industry specific problems.

rows.qualification_required: PhD in appropriate discipline of Engineering/Science in the domain of IT/ITES. Candidate should have strong academic and research background. Background in the domain of Information/Network Security and Cryptography specifically in the Citizen centric secure service delivery. The applicant must have obtained a PhD degree from a recognized University with first class (in terms of grades, etc.) in all preceding levels and a good academic record throughout. The applicant should have completed PhD within the past 5 years on the last date of submission of application.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Post Doctoral Fellow Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit for the fellowship is 40 years on the date of submission of application to the eligible participating institution (host institution). Preference will be given to SC/ST candidates on equal qualifications and experience.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Post Doctoral Fellow Salary
content_sections.text: The fellowship is valid for 1 year or till the end of the project grant whichever is earlier.

rows.pay_level_pay: Rs. 1,08,393/- per month paid directly by PhD Cell, Visvesvaraya PhD scheme, MeitY, Govt. of India after due process at their end.

content_sections.text: The selection process involves application shortlisting based on eligibility and qualifications, followed by an online interview for shortlisted candidates. The interviews shall be in online mode and shortlisted candidates will be informed accordingly. Candidates shall bring along with them the original degree(s)/certificate(s) and experience certificate(s) at the time of interview for verification.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Post Doctoral Fellow
content_sections.text: Prepare an application on plain paper with detailed CV including chronological discipline of degree/certificates obtained. Draft a research proposal defining clear objectives, outcomes and deliverables against the award. Compile experience details including research, industrial field and others. Gather attested copies of degree/certificate and experience certificate. Clearly mention the 'Position Applied for Post Doctoral Fellow in IT/ITES' and Project title in your application. Send the application and documents through email to [email protected] with the subject of the email as 'Application for the post of PDF in IT/ITES'. Ensure submission to the office of Principal Investigator by 14 October 2026, 5:00 PM.

content_sections.heading: IIT Roorkee Post Doctoral Fellow Important Instructions
content_sections.text: The position is a full-time, non-transferable, temporary position tenable in India only. Candidates should ensure that they are eligible for the position they intend to apply before appearing for the interview. No TA/DA is admissible for attending the interview. Selected fellows will work primarily in the Computer Science and Engineering department in the domain of Information/Network Security and Cryptography specifically in the Citizen centric secure service delivery. Awardees need to participate in activities under the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme as assigned by PhD Cell at MeitY and the institute.

faq.question: Q1. What is the recruitment by IIT Roorkee under advertisement SRIC/06?
faq.answer: IIT Roorkee has invited applications for the temporary post of Post Doctoral Fellow (PDF) in IT/ITES under the Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme - Phase II, MeitY, Govt. of India.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy available for the Post Doctoral Fellow (PDF) position in IT/ITES.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Roorkee Post Doctoral Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit applications by email to the office of Principal Investigator is 14 October 2026 up to 5:00 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the required educational qualification?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a PhD in appropriate discipline of Engineering/Science in the domain of IT/ITES, with a background in Information/Network Security and Cryptography, and a first-class academic record throughout.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this fellowship?
faq.answer: The upper age limit for the fellowship is 40 years on the date of submission of application to the host institution.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the Post Doctoral Fellow position?
faq.answer: Candidates should submit their application on plain paper with a detailed CV, research proposal, experience details, and attested copies of certificates via email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises shortlisting of candidates followed by an online interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the monthly salary/emoluments provided?
faq.answer: Selected candidates will receive Rs. 1,08,393 per month paid directly by the PhD Cell, Visvesvaraya PhD Scheme, MeitY, Govt. of India.

faq.question: Q10. What is the duration of the fellowship?
faq.answer: The fellowship is valid for 1 year or till the end of the project grant, whichever is earlier.
